title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - ActivityCalendar
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/ActivityCalendar. [COSEM] This class allows handling various tariff structures in the meter. This class provides a list of scheduled actions, following the classical way of calendar-based schedules by defining seasons, weeks, etc.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ActivityCalendar'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasCalendarNameActive.description: Property. [COSEM] User defined name identifying the active calendar (currently active), which is descriptive to the set of scripts activated by the object.

hasCalendarNamePassive.description: Property. [COSEM] User defined name identifying the passive calendar (will be activated), which is descriptive to the set of scripts activated by the object.

hasActivatePassiveCalendarTime.description: Property. [COSEM] Defines the time when the passive calendar will be activated.

hasActiveSeasonProfile.description: Relationship. [COSEM] Contains a list of active season profiles. These season profiles form an active calendar.

hasPassiveSeasonProfile.description: Relationship. [COSEM] Contains a list of passive season profiles. These season profiles form a passive calendar.

hasObis.description: Property. [COSEM/IEC 62056] OBIS code uniquely identifying this activity calendar COSEM object.
